changelog:
- Default Search Engine: Ecosia is now default for new users (with full customization).
- Live Pulse Hub: Added interactive hub for live news with images, real-time weather, crypto/currencies ticker (BTC, ETH, Gold, S&P 500, EUR/USD), and sports highlights.
- Ghost Mode / Private Tabs: Dedicated header quick-action for instant private browsing.
- Tab Search: Added live search bar in tab switcher to filter open tabs by title and URL.
- Toolbar Position: Added user choice to position the address bar & navigation controls at Top or Bottom.
- Default Browser Option: Added 1-tap 'Set as Default Browser' via Android RoleManager.
- YouTube & Instagram Fixes: Restored YouTube home navigation by keeping brand logo intact; eliminated Instagram Reels scroll stutter and blocked sponsored feed posts.
